verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence is a community comment confirming that Steel publishes developer-tier pricing on both a pricing page and in its docs. The same comment notes the two conflict ($59 vs $99), which undercuts transparency. The pack never shows per-browser-hour or per-task rates, or any documented rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: first-party pricing documentation with per-hour/per-task rates, documented rate limits, documented concurrency limits, consistent pricing across sources.
